status: posthoc exploratory reused known cohort, fixed before fitting; not preregistered or confirmatory
target: single requested initial-order item, return_delivered_order_items only; synthetic digital-device name membership
unit: mean record summary over calls/repeats/tasks with same prompt/customer/order/item; one row per instance per prompt
folds: unchanged original customer 5 folds; separate prompts; pooled OOF
features: c2s and s2c record count,total,max,min; exact oracle known-call slice; no timing/plaintext/identifier features

learners.LR: standard scaler + liblinear C1 balanced, seed20261024 max_iter1000

conditions: constant_size (identical zero feature vectors, same as operation_constant)
order_count_only (initial full-order item rows confounding diagnostic)
shuffled_labels (fixed seed20261024 permutation of unique instance labels within original fold; shared across prompts/repeats)
bootstrap: 2000 fixed prediction customer-cluster resamples, equal instance weighting; one-class draws omitted; percentile95; suite max reselected; no refitting
scope: 15 customers/20 pooled distinct item instances anticipated; no population or general defense-ranking claim
